business_problem: Astronomer is a leading data platform. The company's mission is to deliver the world's data. Astronomer stewards Apache Airflow, the de facto standard for expressing data flows as code and the central control point in the modern data stack.
solution_summary: Data engineers, data scientists, and analysts rely on accessible data to power critical applications and processes. Astronomer is a leading data platform. The company's mission is to deliver the world's data. Astronomer stewards Apache Airflow, the de facto standard for expressing data flows as code and the central control point in the modern data stack. "Apache Airflow dramatically changed the way data pipelines were being developed before Apache Airflow pipelines were actually created, generally point to point with very limited flexibility," says Vikram Koka, SVP of Engineering, Astronomer. Organizations depend on data to power their applications, run critical processes, produce analytics, and deliver AI. However, teams struggle to deliver data reliably, scale their use of data, and implement governance and control. The implementation centers on Microsoft Teams, Azure to support data lake / data warehouse modernization workflows.
